office: the Gambia Immigration Department, fees paid at Ecobank Gambia
note: The biometric passport's fee from 1 May 2025, D100 for the form and D5,000 for the booklet, from the Immigration Department's statement as Gambiana reported it (the Department's site did not answer this client). Validity, processing time and the fees at the enrolment points abroad are leads.

sources.title: Gambiana, Gambians to pay D5,100 for passport from May (22 April 2025)
sources.said: Gambians seeking to acquire a passport will have to pay a new fee of D5,100 starting 1 May 2025, the Gambia Immigration Department has announced. ... the revised fees comprise D100 for the passport form and D5,000 for the passport booklet, payable at EcoBank Gambia Ltd,”
